mechanics_summary: Stages use 300/400 Ki. Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation identifies Super Vegeta 1 as +5% Strike/+10% Ki Blast damage with +5% Ki Blast defense, and Super Vegeta 2 as +10% Strike/+17.5% Ki Blast damage with +5% physical/+12.5% Ki Blast defense. The form's fully charged Ki Blast behavior also inherits the Super Saiyan charged-blast teleport effect. Exact Ki-generation reduction is retained as a separate researched value rather than inferred here.
